evaluations.rationale: Closure is the remaining core: package the repair and run the discriminating robustness suite that folds in every new probe; evidence is already at the regression level.
The open decision point: measure symlink behavior and decide between documenting the limitation and realpath hardening.
Query-string separation is cheap and directly executable, confirming the gate sees only the pathname.
Long-prefix sibling adjacency tests separator-strict comparison; already partially covered, so marginal gain.
Relative-root resolution under a changed working directory is a real configuration variant and cheap to test.
Concurrency is predicted safe because the gate is a per-request synchronous computation; cheap consistency check.
